definitions.gloss: stinting; holding back; being stingy with
definitions.explanation: Reluctantly giving or using something, or withholding what one has. Can refer to being stingy with money, information, effort, or resources.

examples.japanese: ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}し{惜|お}しみ⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧ほしい。
{出|だ}し{惜|お}しみせず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全力|ぜんりょく}→全力：11637_zenryoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}もう→取り組む：04225_torikumu⟧。
examples.english: Let's give it our all without holding back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出|だ}し{惜|お}しみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧せず、⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: He doesn't hold back on his knowledge and teaches us anything.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in the negative ({出|だ}し{惜|お}しみ⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧) to praise someone for being generous with their time, knowledge, or resources. Can also be used critically when someone is being stingy. A compound of ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out) and ⟦{惜|お}しむ→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧ (to grudge).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出|だ}し{惜|お}しみ⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ (to not hold back)
- {出|だ}し{惜|お}しみ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be stingy with)
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出|だ}し{惜|お}しみ (withholding information)
